description:
Get GWAS/QTL study metadata with enhanced filtering capabilities.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table study — one record = one GWAS or molecular-QTL study.
Key: studyId.
Arguments: study_id accepts gwas study (resolved; unknown -> error); gene_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); project_id accepts gwas project (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by studyId asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown nSamples are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. GWAS Catalog, FinnGen, UKB-PPP and QTL studies of OT 25.09 (existence only).

schema.description: At most one of: study_id, trait; study_id, study_type; study_id, gene_id; study_id, min_sample_size; study_id, project_id.

gene_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

project_id.description: Accepts gwas_project; resolved to one identifier (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

study_id.description: Accepts gwas_study; resolved to one gwas_study (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
